tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

11	def mask_pool(x, mask):
12	    """
13	    Args:
14	        x: [D, M]
15	        mask: [N, M]
16	    """
17	    with torch.no_grad():
18	        mask = mask.detach()
19	        mask = (mask > 0).to(mask.dtype)
20	        denorm = mask.sum(dim=(-1), keepdim=True) + 1e-8
21	
22	    mask_pooled_x = torch.einsum(
23	        "dm,nm->nd",
24	        x,
25	        mask / denorm,
26	    )
27	    return mask_pooled_x

30	class CrossAttentionLayer(BaseModule):
31	    """Cross attention layer.
32	
33	    Args:
34	        d_model (int): Model dimension.
35	        num_heads (int): Number of heads.
36	        dropout (float): Dropout rate.
37	    """
38	
39	    def __init__(self, d_model, num_heads, dropout, fix=False):
40	        super().__init__()
41	        self.fix = fix
42	        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
43	            d_model, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
44	        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
45	        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
46	        # todo: why BaseModule doesn't call it without us?
47	        self.init_weights()
48	
49	    def init_weights(self):
50	        """Init weights."""
51	        for p in self.parameters():
52	            if p.dim() > 1:
53	                nn.init.xavier_uniform_(p)
54	
55	    def forward(self, sources, queries, attn_masks=None):
56	        """Forward pass.
57	
58	        Args:
59	            sources (List[Tensor]): of len batch_size,
60	                each of shape (n_points_i, d_model).
61	            queries (List[Tensor]): of len batch_size,
62	                each of shape(n_queries_i, d_model).
63	            attn_masks (List[Tensor] or None): of len batch_size,
64	                each of shape (n_queries, n_points).
65	        
66	        Return:
67	            List[Tensor]: Queries of len batch_size,
68	                each of shape(n_queries_i, d_model).
69	        """
70	        outputs = []
71	        for i in range(len(sources)):
72	            k = v = sources[i]
73	            attn_mask = attn_masks[i] if attn_masks is not None else None
74	            output, _ = self.attn(queries[i], k, v, attn_mask=attn_mask)
75	            if self.fix:
76	                output = self.dropout(output)
77	            output = output + queries[i]
78	            if self.fix:
79	                output = self.norm(output)
80	            outputs.append(output)
81	        return outputs

84	class SelfAttentionLayer(BaseModule):
85	    """Self attention layer.
86	
87	    Args:
88	        d_model (int): Model dimension.
89	        num_heads (int): Number of heads.
90	        dropout (float): Dropout rate.
91	    """
92	
93	    def __init__(self, d_model, num_heads, dropout):
94	        super().__init__()
95	        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
96	            d_model, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True)
97	        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
98	        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
99	
100	    def forward(self, x, interaction_masks=None):
101	        """Forward pass.
102	
103	        Args:
104	            x (List[Tensor]): Queries of len batch_size,
105	                each of shape(n_queries_i, d_model).
106	        
107	        Returns:
108	            List[Tensor]: Queries of len batch_size,
109	                each of shape(n_queries_i, d_model).
110	        """
111	        out = []
112	        for i, y in enumerate(x):
113	            if not interaction_masks:
114	                z, _ = self.attn(y, y, y)
115	            else:
116	                z, _ = self.attn(y, y, y, attn_mask=interaction_masks[i])
117	            z = self.dropout(z) + y
118	            z = self.norm(z)
119	            out.append(z)
120	        return out

123	class FFN(BaseModule):
124	    """Feed forward network.
125	
126	    Args:
127	        d_model (int): Model dimension.
128	        hidden_dim (int): Hidden dimension.
129	        dropout (float): Dropout rate.
130	        activation_fn (str): 'relu' or 'gelu'.
131	    """
132	
133	    def __init__(self, d_model, hidden_dim, dropout, activation_fn):
134	        super().__init__()
135	        self.net = nn.Sequential(
136	            nn.Linear(d_model, hidden_dim),
137	            nn.ReLU() if activation_fn == 'relu' else nn.GELU(),
138	            nn.Dropout(dropout),
139	            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, d_model),
140	            nn.Dropout(dropout))
141	        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
142	
143	    def forward(self, x):
144	        """Forward pass.
145	
146	        Args:
147	            x (List[Tensor]): Queries of len batch_size,
148	                each of shape(n_queries_i, d_model).
149	        
150	        Returns:
151	            List[Tensor]: Queries of len batch_size,
152	                each of shape(n_queries_i, d_model).
153	        """
154	        out = []
155	        for y in x:
156	            z = self.net(y)
157	            z = z + y
158	            z = self.norm(z)
159	            out.append(z)
160	        return out

162	@MODELS.register_module()
163	class QueryDecoder(BaseModule):
164	    """Query decoder.
165	
166	    Args:
167	        num_layers (int): Number of transformer layers.
168	        num_instance_queries (int): Number of instance queries.
169	        num_semantic_queries (int): Number of semantic queries.
170	        num_classes (int): Number of classes.
171	        in_channels (int): Number of input channels.
172	        d_model (int): Number of channels for model layers.
173	        num_heads (int): Number of head in attention layer.
174	        hidden_dim (int): Dimension of attention layer.
175	        dropout (float): Dropout rate for transformer layer.
176	        activation_fn (str): 'relu' of 'gelu'.
177	        iter_pred (bool): Whether to predict iteratively.
178	        attn_mask (bool): Whether to use mask attention.
179	        pos_enc_flag (bool): Whether to use positional enconding.
180	    """
181	
182	    def __init__(self, num_layers, num_instance_queries, num_semantic_queries,
183	                 num_classes, in_channels, d_model, num_heads, hidden_dim,
184	                 dropout, activation_fn, iter_pred, attn_mask, fix_attention,
185	                 objectness_flag, sphere_cls, **kwargs):
186	        super().__init__()
187	        self.objectness_flag = objectness_flag
188	        self.sphere_cls = sphere_cls
189	        self.input_proj = nn.Sequential(
190	            nn.Linear(in_channels, d_model), nn.LayerNorm(d_model), nn.ReLU())
191	        self.num_queries = num_instance_queries + num_semantic_queries
192	        if num_instance_queries + num_semantic_queries > 0:
193	            self.query = nn.Embedding(num_instance_queries + num_semantic_queries, d_model)
194	        if num_instance_queries == 0:
195	            self.query_proj = nn.Sequential(
196	                nn.Linear(in_channels, d_model), nn.ReLU(),
197	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model))
198	        self.cross_attn_layers = nn.ModuleList([])
199	        self.self_attn_layers = nn.ModuleList([])
200	        self.ffn_layers = nn.ModuleList([])
201	        for i in range(num_layers):
202	            self.cross_attn_layers.append(
203	                CrossAttentionLayer(
204	                    d_model, num_heads, dropout, fix_attention))
205	            self.self_attn_layers.append(
206	                SelfAttentionLayer(d_model, num_heads, dropout))
207	            self.ffn_layers.append(
208	                FFN(d_model, hidden_dim, dropout, activation_fn))
209	        self.out_norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
210	        if not self.sphere_cls:
211	            self.out_cls = nn.Sequential(
212	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(),
213	                nn.Linear(d_model, num_classes + 1))
214	        if objectness_flag:
215	            self.out_score = nn.Sequential(
216	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(d_model, 1))
217	        self.x_mask = nn.Sequential(
218	            nn.Linear(in_channels, d_model), nn.ReLU(),
219	            nn.Linear(d_model, d_model))
220	        self.iter_pred = iter_pred
221	        self.attn_mask = attn_mask
222	    
223	    def _get_queries(self, queries=None, batch_size=None):
224	        """Get query tensor.
225	
226	        Args:
227	            queries (List[Tensor], optional): of len batch_size,
228	                each of shape (n_queries_i, in_channels).
229	            batch_size (int, optional): batch size.
230	        
231	        Returns:
232	            List[Tensor]: of len batch_size, each of shape
233	                (n_queries_i, d_model).
234	        """
235	        if batch_size is None:
236	            batch_size = len(queries)
237	        
238	        result_queries = []
239	        for i in range(batch_size):
240	            result_query = []
241	            if hasattr(self, 'query'):
242	                result_query.append(self.query.weight)
243	            if queries is not None:
244	                result_query.append(self.query_proj(queries[i]))
245	            result_queries.append(torch.cat(result_query))
246	        return result_queries
247	
248	    def _forward_head(self, queries, mask_feats):
249	        """Prediction head forward.
250	
251	        Args:
252	            queries (List[Tensor] | Tensor): List of len batch_size,
253	                each of shape (n_queries_i, d_model). Or tensor of
254	                shape (batch_size, n_queries, d_model).
255	            mask_feats (List[Tensor]): of len batch_size,
256	                each of shape (n_points_i, d_model).
257	
258	        Returns:
259	            Tuple:
260	                List[Tensor]: Classification predictions of len batch_size,
261	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_classes + 1).
262	                List[Tensor]: Confidence scores of len batch_size,
263	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, 1).
264	                List[Tensor]: Predicted masks of len batch_size,
265	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_points_i).
266	                List[Tensor] or None: Attention masks of len batch_size,
267	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_points_i).
268	        """
269	        cls_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, attn_masks = [], [], [], []
270	        for i in range(len(queries)):
271	            norm_query = self.out_norm(queries[i])
272	            cls_preds.append(self.out_cls(norm_query))
273	            pred_score = self.out_score(norm_query) if self.objectness_flag \
274	                else None
275	            pred_scores.append(pred_score)
276	            pred_mask = torch.einsum('nd,md->nm', norm_query, mask_feats[i])
277	            if self.attn_mask:
278	                attn_mask = (pred_mask.sigmoid() < 0.5).bool()
279	                attn_mask[torch.where(
280	                    attn_mask.sum(-1) == attn_mask.shape[-1])] = False
281	                attn_mask = attn_mask.detach()
282	                attn_masks.append(attn_mask)
283	            pred_masks.append(pred_mask)
284	        attn_masks = attn_masks if self.attn_mask else None
285	        return cls_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, attn_masks
286	
287	    def forward_simple(self, x, queries):
288	        """Simple forward pass.
289	        
290	        Args:
291	            x (List[Tensor]): of len batch_size, each of shape
292	                (n_points_i, in_channels).
293	            queries (List[Tensor], optional): of len batch_size, each of shape
294	                (n_points_i, in_channles).
295	        
296	        Returns:
297	            Dict: with labels, masks, and scores.
298	        """
299	        inst_feats = [self.input_proj(y) for y in x]
300	        mask_feats = [self.x_mask(y) for y in x]
301	        queries = self._get_queries(queries, len(x))
302	        for i in range(len(self.cross_attn_layers)):
303	            queries = self.cross_attn_layers[i](inst_feats, queries)
304	            queries = self.self_attn_layers[i](queries)
305	            queries = self.ffn_layers[i](queries)
306	        cls_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, _ = self._forward_head(
307	            queries, mask_feats)

373	class UnifiedQueryDecoder(QueryDecoder):
374	    """We simply add semantic prediction for each instance query.
375	    """
376	    def __init__(self, num_instance_classes, num_semantic_classes,
377	                 d_model, num_semantic_linears, sphere_cls, vocabulary_cls_embedding_path, **kwargs):
378	        super().__init__(
379	            num_classes=num_instance_classes, d_model=d_model, sphere_cls= sphere_cls, **kwargs)
380	        if not self.sphere_cls:
381	            assert num_semantic_linears in [1, 2]
382	            if num_semantic_linears == 2:
383	                self.out_sem = nn.Sequential(
384	                    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(),
385	                    nn.Linear(d_model, num_semantic_classes + 1))
386	            else:
387	                self.out_sem = nn.Linear(d_model, num_semantic_classes + 1)
388	            
389	        if self.sphere_cls:
390	            rank, world_size = get_dist_info()
391	            cls_embed = torch.load(vocabulary_cls_embedding_path)
392	            
393	            _dim = cls_embed.size(2)
394	            _prototypes = cls_embed.size(1)
395	
396	            if rank == 0:
397	                back_token = torch.zeros(1, _dim, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
398	            else:
399	                back_token = torch.empty(1, _dim, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
400	            if world_size > 1:
401	                dist.broadcast(back_token, src=0)
402	            back_token = back_token.to(device='cpu')
403	            cls_embed = torch.cat([
404	                cls_embed, back_token.repeat(_prototypes, 1)[None]
405	            ], dim=0)
406	            self.register_buffer('cls_embed', cls_embed.permute(2, 0, 1).contiguous(), persistent=False)
407	            
408	            cls_embed_dim = self.cls_embed.size(0)
409	            self.cls_proj = nn.Sequential(
410	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
411	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
412	                nn.Linear(d_model, cls_embed_dim))
413	            
414	            self.cls_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(
415	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
416	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
417	                nn.Linear(d_model, cls_embed_dim))
418	            
419	            logit_scale = torch.tensor(4.6052, dtype=torch.float32)
420	            self.register_buffer('logit_scale', logit_scale, persistent=False)
421	            
422	            # Mask Pooling
423	            self.mask_pooling = mask_pool
424	            self.mask_pooling_proj = nn.Sequential(
425	                nn.LayerNorm(d_model),
426	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
427	            )
428	            
429	            self.mask_pooling_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(
430	                nn.LayerNorm(d_model),
431	                nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
432	            )
433	    def forward_logit(self, cls_embd, sem=False):
434	        if sem:
435	            cls_pred = torch.einsum('nd,dkp->nkp', F.normalize(cls_embd, dim=-1), self.cls_embed)
436	        else:
437	            cls_pred = torch.einsum('nd,dkp->nkp', F.normalize(cls_embd, dim=-1), self.cls_embed[:, 2:, :])
438	        cls_pred = cls_pred.max(-1).values
439	        cls_pred = self.logit_scale.exp() * cls_pred
440	        return cls_pred
441	    
442	    def _forward_head(self, queries, mask_feats, last_flag):
443	        """Prediction head forward.
444	
445	        Args:
446	            queries (List[Tensor] | Tensor): List of len batch_size,
447	                each of shape (n_queries_i, d_model). Or tensor of
448	                shape (batch_size, n_queries, d_model).
449	            mask_feats (List[Tensor]): of len batch_size,
450	                each of shape (n_points_i, d_model).
451	
452	        Returns:
453	            Tuple:
454	                List[Tensor]: Classification predictions of len batch_size,
455	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_instance_classes + 1).
456	                List[Tensor] or None: Semantic predictions of len batch_size,
457	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_semantic_classes + 1).
458	                List[Tensor]: Confidence scores of len batch_size,
459	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, 1).
460	                List[Tensor]: Predicted masks of len batch_size,
461	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_points_i).
462	                List[Tensor] or None: Attention masks of len batch_size,
463	                    each of shape (n_queries_i, n_points_i).
464	        """
465	        cls_preds, sem_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, attn_masks = \
466	            [], [], [], [], []
467	        for i in range(len(queries)):
468	            norm_query = self.out_norm(queries[i])
469	            if not self.sphere_cls:
470	                cls_preds.append(self.out_cls(norm_query))
471	                if last_flag:
472	                    sem_preds.append(self.out_sem(norm_query))
473	     
474	            pred_score = self.out_score(norm_query) if self.objectness_flag \
475	                else None
476	            pred_scores.append(pred_score)
477	            pred_mask = torch.einsum('nd,md->nm', norm_query, mask_feats[i])
478	            
479	            if self.sphere_cls:
480	                maskpool_ = self.mask_pooling(x=mask_feats[i].T, mask=pred_mask.detach())
481	                
482	                maskpool_embd = self.mask_pooling_proj(maskpool_) 
483	                cls_embd = self.cls_proj(maskpool_embd + norm_query) 
484	                cls_pred = self.forward_logit(cls_embd) 
485	                cls_preds.append(cls_pred)
486	                if last_flag:
487	                    norm_query_sem = norm_query.clone()
488	                    maskpool_embd_sem  = self.mask_pooling_proj_sem(maskpool_)
489	                    cls_embd_sem = self.cls_proj_sem(maskpool_embd_sem + norm_query_sem)
490	                    cls_pred_sem = self.forward_logit(cls_embd_sem, sem=True)
491	                    sem_preds.append(cls_pred_sem)
492	                
493	            if self.attn_mask:
494	                attn_mask = (pred_mask.sigmoid() < 0.5).bool()
495	                attn_mask[torch.where(
496	                    attn_mask.sum(-1) == attn_mask.shape[-1])] = False
497	                attn_mask = attn_mask.detach()
498	                attn_masks.append(attn_mask)
499	            pred_masks.append(pred_mask)
500	        attn_masks = attn_masks if self.attn_mask else None
501	        sem_preds = sem_preds if last_flag else None
502	        return cls_preds, sem_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, attn_masks
503	
504	    def forward_simple(self, x, queries):
505	        """Simple forward pass.

509	                (n_points_i, in_channels).

511	                (n_points_i, in_channles).

513	        Returns:
514	            Dict: with instance scores, semantic scores, masks, and scores.
515	        """
516	        inst_feats = [self.input_proj(y) for y in x]
517	        mask_feats = [self.x_mask(y) for y in x]
518	        queries = self._get_queries(queries, len(x))
519	        for i in range(len(self.cross_attn_layers)):

521	            queries = self.self_attn_layers[i](queries)
522	            queries = self.ffn_layers[i](queries)
523	        cls_preds, sem_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, _= self._forward_head(
524	            queries, mask_feats, last_flag=True)
525	        return dict(
526	            cls_preds=cls_preds,
527	            sem_preds=sem_preds,
528	            masks=pred_masks,
529	            scores=pred_scores,)

531	    def forward_iter_pred(self, x, queries, interaction_masks=None):
532	        """Iterative forward pass.
533	        
534	        Args:
535	            x (List[Tensor]): of len batch_size, each of shape
536	                (n_points_i, in_channels).
537	            queries (List[Tensor], optional): of len batch_size, each of shape
538	                (n_points_i, in_channles).
539	        
540	        Returns:
541	            Dict: with instance scores, semantic scores, masks, scores,
542	                and aux_outputs.
543	        """
544	        cls_preds, sem_preds, pred_scores, pred_masks, contras_embeds = [], [], [], [], []
545	        inst_feats = [self.input_proj(y) for y in x]
546	        mask_feats = [self.x_mask(y) for y in x]
547	        queries = self._get_queries(queries, len(x))
548	        cls_pred, sem_pred, pred_score, pred_mask, attn_mask= \

551	        sem_preds.append(sem_pred)
552	        pred_scores.append(pred_score)
553	        pred_masks.append(pred_mask)
554	        contras_embeds.append([self.out_norm(queries[i].clone()) for i in range(len(queries))])
555	        
556	        for i in range(len(self.cross_attn_layers)):
557	            queries = self.cross_attn_layers[i](inst_feats, queries, attn_mask)
558	            queries = self.self_attn_layers[i](queries, interaction_masks=interaction_masks)
559	            queries = self.ffn_layers[i](queries)
560	            last_flag = i == len(self.cross_attn_layers) - 1
561	            cls_pred, sem_pred, pred_score, pred_mask, attn_mask = \
562	                self._forward_head(queries, mask_feats, last_flag)
563	            cls_preds.append(cls_pred)
564	            sem_preds.append(sem_pred)
565	            pred_scores.append(pred_score)
566	            pred_masks.append(pred_mask)
567	            contras_embeds.append([self.out_norm(queries[i].clone()) for i in range(len(queries))])
568	
569	        aux_outputs = [
570	            dict(
571	                cls_preds=cls_pred,
572	                sem_preds=sem_pred,
573	                masks=masks,
574	                scores=scores,
575	                contras_embeds=contras_embeds)
576	            for cls_pred, sem_pred, scores, masks, contras_embeds in zip(
577	                cls_preds[:-1], sem_preds[:-1],
578	                pred_scores[:-1], pred_masks[:-1], contras_embeds[:-1])]
579	        return dict(
580	            cls_preds=cls_preds[-1],
581	            sem_preds=sem_preds[-1],

583	            scores=pred_scores[-1],
584	            contras_embeds=contras_embeds[-1],
585	            aux_outputs=aux_outputs)

5	def mask_pool(x, mask):
6	    """
7	    Args:
8	        x: [D, M]
9	        mask: [N, M]
10	    """
11	    with torch.no_grad():
12	        mask = mask.detach()
13	        mask = (mask > 0).to(mask.dtype)
14	        denorm = mask.sum(dim=(-1), keepdim=True) + 1e-8
15	
16	    mask_pooled_x = torch.einsum(
17	        "dm,nm->nd",
18	        x,
19	        mask / denorm,
20	    )
21	    return mask_pooled_x

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

from mmdet3d.registry import MODELS


@MODELS.register_module()
class ScanNetSemanticCriterion:
    """Semantic criterion for ScanNet.

    Args:
        ignore_index (int): Ignore index.
        loss_weight (float): Loss weight.
    """

    def __init__(self, ignore_index, loss_weight):
        self.ignore_index = ignore_index
        self.loss_weight = loss_weight

    def __call__(self, pred, insts):
        """Calculate loss.

        Args:
            pred (dict): Predictions with List `sem_preds`
                of len batch_size, each of shape
                (n_queries_i, n_classes + 1).
            insts (list): Ground truth of len batch_size, 
                each InstanceData_ with `sp_masks` of shape
                (n_classes + 1, n_queries_i).

        Returns:
            Dict: with semantic loss value.
        """
        losses = []
        for pred_mask, gt_mask in zip(pred['sem_preds'], insts):
            if self.ignore_index >= 0:
                pred_mask = pred_mask[:, :-1]
            losses.append(F.cross_entropy(
                pred_mask,
                gt_mask.sp_masks.float().argmax(0),
                ignore_index=self.ignore_index))
        loss = self.loss_weight * torch.mean(torch.stack(losses))
        return dict(seg_loss=loss)

# u4-l4 UnifiedQueryDecoder：CLIP 词表分类与 mask pooling

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u4-l3）我们读完了 `QueryDecoder` 的骨架：超点即查询、掩码注意力、迭代预测，并在结尾留下一个悬念——「分类改走球面分类路径，语义分支仅在最后一层计算」。本讲就把这个悬念拆开：

1. 理解 `sphere_cls`（球面分类）如何用**外部文本原型**替代传统线性分类头，以及这对开放词汇分割的意义。
2. 掌握 `mask_pool` 的 einsum 归一化池化：如何从「预测掩码内部的点特征」汇取出每个查询的分类特征。
3. 读懂 `forward_logit` 中 max-over-prototypes 与 `logit_scale` 的作用。
4. 区分实例分类与语义分类**两套投影头**（`cls_proj` / `cls_proj_sem`、`mask_pooling_proj` / `mask_pooling_proj_sem`），以及 `last_flag` 控制的语义分支时机。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 线性分类头 vs 原型分类

传统分割模型的分类头是一个可学习矩阵：

\[ \text{logits} = W q + b, \quad W \in \mathbb{R}^{(K+1) \times d} \]

它有两个特点：**权重是训练学出来的**、**类别数 K 在建模时就钉死了**。想新增一个类别，就必须改网络、重新训练。

原型（prototype）分类换了一种思路：每个类别的「权重向量」不由训练得到，而是用**文本编码器**（这里是 OpenCLIP）对一个类别名的文本嵌入来充当。分类变成计算查询嵌入与各类原型的**余弦相似度**：

\[ \cos(e, c) = \frac{\langle e, c \rangle}{\|e\| \, \|c\|} \]

由于归一化后的向量都落在单位超球面上，这种分类常被称为**球面分类**（sphere classification）。它正是 CLIP 做零样本分类的方式——想换类别，只需换一组文本嵌入，网络结构不动。这就是 `sphere_cls=True` 的含义，也是 UniSeg3D 开放词汇能力（u6-l3）与文本-视觉对齐（u4-l5、u5-l6）的基石。

### 2.2 mask pooling（掩码池化）

分类不能只看查询向量本身——两个「椅子」查询和两个「桌子」查询的向量可能很接近，但它们**掩住的点**截然不同。mask pooling 的做法是：用预测掩码圈出点（这里是超点）特征，在掩码内做**平均池化**，得到「这个查询掩住了什么东西」的特征，再与查询向量相加后送去分类。这一思想来自 Mask2Former 等二阶段掩码分类模型。

### 2.3 需要的背景概念

- **buffer（`register_buffer`）**：PyTorch 中随模型保存/移动但不参与梯度更新的张量；`persistent=False` 表示**不写入 state_dict**（checkpoint）。
- **DDP 广播（`dist.broadcast`）**：多卡训练时把 rank 0 的张量广播到所有进程，保证各卡的常量完全一致。
- **einsum**：用下标字符串描述张量运算，如 `'nd,md->nm'` 表示两个矩阵相乘。
- 承接 u4-l3：解码器每层输出 `pred_mask = einsum('nd,md->nm', norm_query, mask_feats)`，本讲的池化与分类都建立在这份掩码之上。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [uniseg3d/query_decoder.py](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py) | 本讲主角。`UnifiedQueryDecoder`（L372 起）继承 `QueryDecoder`；含原型加载（L389-L432）、`forward_logit`（L433-L440）、改造版 `_forward_head`（L442-L502）。文件顶部 L11-L27 还有一份内嵌的 `mask_pool` |
| [uniseg3d/mask_pool.py](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/mask_pool.py) | 独立的 `mask_pool` 函数（与 query_decoder.py 内嵌那份逐字相同），只依赖 torch，便于单独复用与测试 |
| [configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py) | decoder 配置块 L47-L66：`sphere_cls=True`、原型文件路径、类别数；`stuff_classes=[0,1]`（L136）对应实例分类时被丢弃的前两类 |
| [uniseg3d/semantic_criterion.py](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/semantic_criterion.py) | 语义损失如何消费 `sem_preds`（仅一句带过，细节在 u5-l1） |
| [README.md](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/README.md) | L124-L126：`scannet_cls_embedding.pth` 的下载方式与来源说明 |

辅助背景：`data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth` 是**从官方 Release 下载**的类别原型文件，仓库内没有生成它的脚本（u1-l4 已确认）。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 cls_embed：类别原型加载与 back_token 广播

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

球面分类需要一个「类别 → 原型向量」的查找表。UniSeg3D 把这张表做成了一个三维张量文件 `data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth`，其布局为：

\[ \text{cls\_embed} \in \mathbb{R}^{C \times P \times D} \]

- \( C \)：类别数。由代码与配置联立可推出 **C = 20**（20 个 ScanNet 语义类，详见 4.1.2）。
- \( P \)：每个类别的**原型个数**。一个类可以用多条文本模板（如 "a chair" / "a seat with legs"）各编码一个原型，推理时取最大相似度——代码不关心 P 具体是多少，直接 `size(1)` 读出（具体数值待本地验证）。
- \( D \)：CLIP 文本嵌入维度。原型与语言分支（u4-l5）用同一个 OpenCLIP 模型编码（README L126），`convnext_large_d_320` 的文本维是 768，但确切值以文件为准（待本地验证）。

模型侧还要补一个**背景类**（back_token）：一个全零原型，充当「我不是任何东西」的第 \(C+1\) 类。这一步在 `__init__` 里完成，并把结果注册为 buffer。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
torch.load(pth)                          # (C, P, D)
读取 _dim=D、_prototypes=P
rank0 造全零 back_token(1, D)，其余 rank 造空张量
dist.broadcast 对齐所有卡                  # 保证背景原型各卡一致
back_token.repeat(P, 1)[None]            # (1, P, D)
cat 到类别维                             # (C+1, P, D)
permute(2, 0, 1)                         # (D, C+1, P) ← 方便 einsum
register_buffer('cls_embed', persistent=False)
```

两个关键推论（由 `forward_logit` 的切片反推，4.3 详述）：

- **语义分类**用全部 \(C+1\) 行 → logits 有 \(C+1 = 21\) 列 = `num_semantic_classes(20) + 1`，与配置 [configs/...py:L11](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L11) 一致；
- **实例分类**丢弃前 2 行（wall=0、floor=1 两个 stuff 类，对应配置 `stuff_classes=[0, 1]`）→ \(C-1 = 19\) 列 = `num_instance_classes(18) + 1`（18 个 thing 类 + 背景），与 [configs/...py:L10](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L10) 一致。

因此 **C 必为 20**——这正是「语义类去掉 2 个 stuff 类 = 实例类」的类别体系。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

配置侧打开球面分类并指定原型文件（[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:L47-L66](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L47-L66)）：解码器为 `UnifiedQueryDecoder`，`sphere_cls = True`，`vocabulary_cls_embedding_path = 'data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth'`。

原型加载与 back_token 广播（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L389-L406](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L389-L406)）：

```python
if self.sphere_cls:
    rank, world_size = get_dist_info()
    cls_embed = torch.load(vocabulary_cls_embedding_path)

    _dim = cls_embed.size(2)        # D
    _prototypes = cls_embed.size(1) # P

    if rank == 0:
        back_token = torch.zeros(1, _dim, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
    else:
        back_token = torch.empty(1, _dim, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
    if world_size > 1:
        dist.broadcast(back_token, src=0)
    back_token = back_token.to(device='cpu')
    cls_embed = torch.cat([
        cls_embed, back_token.repeat(_prototypes, 1)[None]
    ], dim=0)
    self.register_buffer('cls_embed', cls_embed.permute(2, 0, 1).contiguous(),
                         persistent=False)
```

这段代码做了三件事：

1. **加载原型**并读出 \(P\)、\(D\)；`back_token.repeat(_prototypes, 1)[None]` 把 1 个零向量复制成 (1, P, D)，即背景类也有 P 个（全零）原型，与其它类形状对齐。
2. **DDP 安全**：rank 0 造零、其余 rank 造未初始化内存、广播对齐——确保多卡训练时背景原型 bit 级一致。注意 `device='cuda'`：**在没有 GPU 的机器上无法实例化 `UnifiedQueryDecoder(sphere_cls=True)`**，做实验时要么用 GPU，要么像本讲实践那样手工复现流水线。
3. **`persistent=False`**：`cls_embed` 不进 checkpoint。好处是换词表不用改权重文件；代价是**任何构建模型的环境（包括纯推理）都必须存在这个 pth 文件**，否则 `torch.load` 直接报错。

两个线性分类头在球面模式下**根本不会被创建**（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L210-L213](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L210-L213) 与 [L380-L387](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L380-L387)）：`out_cls` 与 `out_sem` 都被 `if not self.sphere_cls` 守卫。所以球面分类不是「并列选项」，而是**完全替换**了分类参数——模型里不存在 \(19 \times 256\) 或 \(21 \times 256\) 的可学习分类矩阵。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：亲手「体检」原型文件，验证 4.1.2 推出的三个维度与归一化假设。

**操作步骤**（在按 u1-l2 装好的环境中，项目根目录执行）：

```python
# 示例代码：inspect_prototypes.py
import torch
cls_embed = torch.load('data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth')
print('形状:', cls_embed.shape)          # 期望 (20, P, D)
print('dtype:', cls_embed.dtype)
print('每类原型的 L2 范数（按最后一维）:',
      cls_embed.norm(dim=2).mean().item())
```

**需要观察的现象**：

1. 第一维是否为 20；第三维是否为 768（与 `LangModule` 的 `input_channels=768` 对齐）。
2. 原型范数均值是否接近 1.0——`forward_logit` 只对查询侧做了 `F.normalize`，原型侧默认文件出厂时已归一化（README 称 "Processed ... embeddings"），范数 ≈ 1 即验证了这一点。

**预期结果**：形状 (20, P, 768)、范数均值 ≈ 1.0。**文件未下载或数值待本地验证**（P 的具体值无法从源码推出）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `cls_embed` 要 `permute(2, 0, 1)` 存成 (D, C+1, P)，而不是保持 (C+1, P, D)？

**答案**：为了与 `forward_logit` 里的 `einsum('nd,dkp->nkp', ...)` 下标约定对齐——einsum 要求参与运算的维度按下标出现，把嵌入维 D 放到 dim0 后，查询嵌入 (n, d) 可以直接与原型 (d, k, p) 相乘，不需要额外转置；同时实例分类的「丢掉前两类」变成一个直观的 `[:, 2:, :]` 切片。

**练习 2**：删掉 `data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth` 后加载一个训练好的 checkpoint 做推理，会发生什么？为什么？

**答案**：会在**构建模型阶段**就报错（`torch.load` 文件不存在），根本轮不到加载 checkpoint。因为 `persistent=False`，原型不随 checkpoint 保存，每次实例化 `UnifiedQueryDecoder` 都要重新读 pth——推理环境同样依赖该文件。

**练习 3**：back_token 为什么要在 rank 0 上 `zeros`、其它 rank 上 `empty` 再广播，而不是每张卡各自 `zeros`？

**答案**：这是多进程训练中的防御性写法。虽然 `zeros` 本身是确定性的，但该模式能确保「所有 rank 上的 buffer 来自同一次初始化」，杜绝任何 rank 间数值不一致的可能（这类写法常见于需要随机初始化再对齐的常量场景）；广播后统一搬回 CPU 参与后续 `torch.cat`。

### 4.2 mask_pool 与两个池化投影头

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`mask_pool` 回答的问题是：**「第 n 个查询掩住的区域长什么样？」**

输入是点（超点）特征矩阵 \(X \in \mathbb{R}^{D_{in} \times M}\)（\(D_{in}=256=d\_model\)，\(M\) 为该场景超点数）和掩码 logits \(M_{logit} \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times M}\)（\(N\) 为查询数）。它先把 logits 二值化（>0 即视为掩内），再做**归一化平均**：

\[ x_n^{pool} = \frac{\sum_{m} \mathbb{1}[M_{logit,n,m} > 0] \cdot X_{:,m}}{\sum_{m} \mathbb{1}[M_{logit,n,m} > 0] + 10^{-8}} \in \mathbb{R}^{D_{in}} \]

分母加 `1e-8` 防止「掩码全空」的查询除零。两个工程细节值得注意：

- **掩码侧梯度被切断**：`with torch.no_grad()` + `mask.detach()`，池化只把掩码当「区域选择器」，梯度只回流到点特征 \(X\)（即 `mask_feats`）上。掩码 logits 自己的监督来自掩码损失（u5）。
- **二值化阈值是 0（logit）而非 0.5（概率）**：等价于对 sigmoid 概率取 0.5 阈值，与解码器里生成注意力掩码的阈值一致（u4-l3）。

池化结果随后经**两套对称的投影头**加工：

| 头 | 结构 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mask_pooling_proj` | LayerNorm + Linear(256→256) | 实例分类分支的池化投影 |
| `mask_pooling_proj_sem` | LayerNorm + Linear(256→256) | 语义分类分支的池化投影（独立参数） |
| `cls_proj` | Linear-ReLU ×2 + Linear(256→D) | 池化特征+查询 → 实例分类嵌入 |
| `cls_proj_sem` | Linear-ReLU ×2 + Linear(256→D) | 池化特征+查询 → 语义分类嵌入 |

实例与语义**各自一套完整参数**，互不共享——因为两个任务的类别空间与判别习惯不同（实例要区分「哪把椅子」，语义只需「是椅子」）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
mask_feats[i]                # (M, 256) 点(超点)特征
        │ .T
        ▼
mask_pool(x=(256, M),        mask=pred_mask.detach() (N, M)
        │  内部: logits>0 二值化 → 行归一化 → einsum('dm,nm->nd')
        ▼
maskpool_ (N, 256)           # 每个查询「掩住区域」的平均特征
        ├── mask_pooling_proj     ──┐
        └── mask_pooling_proj_sem ──┤（同一份 maskpool_ 喂两个头）
                                    ▼
              各自 + norm_query → cls_proj / cls_proj_sem → 球面分类
```

注意一个容易被忽略的点：**语义分支复用的是同一份 `maskpool_`**（来自实例掩码的池化），只是后续投影不同。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

`mask_pool` 函数（[uniseg3d/mask_pool.py:L5-L21](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/mask_pool.py#L5-L21)）：

```python
def mask_pool(x, mask):
    """
    Args:
        x: [D, M]
        mask: [N, M]
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        mask = mask.detach()
        mask = (mask > 0).to(mask.dtype)
        denorm = mask.sum(dim=(-1), keepdim=True) + 1e-8

    mask_pooled_x = torch.einsum(
        "dm,nm->nd",
        x,
        mask / denorm,
    )
    return mask_pooled_x
```

`no_grad` 块只包住掩码处理；`einsum` 在块外，因此梯度经 `x` 正常回传、经 `mask` 断流。`mask / denorm` 让每行权重和为 1（掩内点的平均）。

四个投影头与池化函数的组装（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L408-L432](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L408-L432)）：

```python
cls_embed_dim = self.cls_embed.size(0)          # = D，原型嵌入维
self.cls_proj = nn.Sequential(                  # 实例分类嵌入
    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
    nn.Linear(d_model, cls_embed_dim))
self.cls_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(...)          # 同构，语义版

self.mask_pooling = mask_pool                   # 函数别名
self.mask_pooling_proj = nn.Sequential(         # 实例池化投影
    nn.LayerNorm(d_model), nn.Linear(d_model, d_model))
self.mask_pooling_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(...) # 语义池化投影
```

两点说明：

1. `cls_proj` 的输出维是 `cls_embed_dim = self.cls_embed.size(0)`，即 permute 后的 dim0 = \(D\)。**投影头把 256 维查询空间升维到 CLIP 文本空间**，与原型做相似度——这正是「把视觉查询翻译到语言空间」的接口。
2. `self.mask_pooling = mask_pool` 里的 `mask_pool` 是 **query_decoder.py 自己内嵌的那份**（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L11-L27](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L11-L27)），与 mask_pool.py 逐字相同但互不引用；`uniseg3d/__init__.py` 也不导入 mask_pool.py，所以它是一份「独立工具副本」，恰好方便我们单独测试。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：脱离整个模型，单独验证 `mask_pool` 的数值行为与梯度断流。

**操作步骤**（只需 torch，不必装 mmdet3d；示例代码）：

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `mask_pool` 要对 mask 做 `detach`，而不让分类损失也顺便监督掩码？

**答案**：让分类梯度直接改掩码会造成训练不稳定——分类头会「教」掩码去圈住容易分类的区域而非真实物体边界，与掩码损失（BCE/Dice，u5）的目标冲突。detach 后掩码只作二值区域选择器，分类损失监督的是「如何在给定区域内聚合特征」（mask_feats 与投影头），各损失职责清晰。

**练习 2**：`mask_pooling_proj` 里为什么先 `LayerNorm` 再 `Linear`，而不是像 `cls_proj` 那样用 ReLU？

**答案**：池化输出是掩内特征的**加权平均**，量纲由 mask_feats 决定且随掩码大小波动；LayerNorm 先把它拉回稳定分布再仿射，稳住后续与 `norm_query`（本身经过 `out_norm`）相加时的尺度。`cls_proj` 处理的输入已是归一化向量之和，用 ReLU 增加非线性即可。（这是合理的工程解读；原文未附注释，属源码阅读推断。）

**练习 3**：一个查询的掩码 logits 全为负时，`mask_pool` 返回什么？这个结果送进 `cls_proj` 后会发生什么？

**答案**：二值掩码全 0，`einsum` 结果为全零向量（分母 1e-8）。全零池化特征 + `norm_query` 后仍可分类，即「这个查询没掩住任何点」时分类完全退化为只看查询向量本身——深监督下这类查询通常会被背景原型（相似度 0）压制成低置信度。

### 4.3 forward_logit：相似度分类（max-over-prototypes 与 logit_scale）

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`forward_logit` 是球面分类的「最后一步」：把投影到 CLIP 空间的查询嵌入 \(e_n \in \mathbb{R}^{D}\) 与原型张量 \(\text{cls\_embed} \in \mathbb{R}^{D \times (C+1) \times P}\) 做相似度，输出每个查询对每个类的 logit：

\[ \text{logit}_{n,k} = \tau \cdot \max_{p=1..P} \; \langle \hat{e}_n,\; c_{k,p} \rangle, \qquad \hat{e}_n = \frac{e_n}{\|e_n\|_2}, \quad \tau = e^{4.6052} \approx 100 \]

三个成分各司其职：

1. **余弦相似度**：查询侧 `F.normalize`；原型侧默认文件已归一化（4.1.4 验证）。取值域 \([-1, 1]\)。
2. **max-over-prototypes**：一个类有 P 个原型（多模板），取最大相似度——「与该类任一说法最像就算像」，比平均更符合多模板语义，也让 P 的大小不改变语义。
3. **logit_scale = 4.6052**：`exp(4.6052) ≈ 100`，这是 CLIP 温度参数的初始值。余弦取值太「扁」（好样本 0.3、坏样本 0.2 就差很多），乘 100 拉开差距，使后续 softmax/交叉熵有足够陡的分布。它是 buffer（不训练）。

**实例/语义两条路径的差异只有一处切片**：

- 语义（`sem=True`）：用全部原型 → \(C+1 = 21\) 列（20 类 + 背景列，背景列随后被语义损失切掉，见下）。
- 实例（`sem=False`）：`cls_embed[:, 2:, :]` 丢掉 wall/floor 两个 stuff 类 → \(C-1 = 19\) 列（18 个 thing 类 + 背景）。

**背景列恒为 0 的推论**：back_token 是全零原型，与任何归一化向量的内积为 0，max 后仍是 0，乘 \(\tau\) 还是 0。于是实例 logits 中背景列**恒等于 0**：当某查询与所有 thing 类原型的余弦都 ≤ 0 时，argmax 落在背景列——一个简洁的「无对象」机制。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
cls_embd (N, D)                    # 来自 cls_proj / cls_proj_sem
    │ F.normalize(dim=-1)
    ▼
einsum('nd,dkp->nkp')              # (N, 21, P) 或切片后 (N, 19, P)
    │ max(-1)                      # 对 P 个原型取最大
    ▼
(N, 21) / (N, 19)
    │ × logit_scale.exp() ≈ ×100
    ▼
sem_logits (N,21) / inst_logits (N,19)
```

下游消费方式（一句话带过，细节在 u5）：

- 语义：[uniseg3d/semantic_criterion.py:L35-L41](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/semantic_criterion.py#L35-L41) 先 `pred_mask[:, :-1]` 切掉最后的背景列，再做交叉熵（`ignore_index=20`）。
- 实例：u5-l3 的 `OVInstanceCriterion` 对 19 列做监督，最后一列即「非物体」通道。
- 推理：[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:L110-L115](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L110-L115) 用 `F.softmax(cls_preds, dim=-1)[:, :-1]` 得到实例置信度（同样切掉背景列），可再乘 IoU 预测分数（u5-l4）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L433-L440](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L433-L440)：

```python
def forward_logit(self, cls_embd, sem=False):
    if sem:
        cls_pred = torch.einsum('nd,dkp->nkp',
            F.normalize(cls_embd, dim=-1), self.cls_embed)
    else:
        cls_pred = torch.einsum('nd,dkp->nkp',
            F.normalize(cls_embd, dim=-1), self.cls_embed[:, 2:, :])
    cls_pred = cls_pred.max(-1).values
    cls_pred = self.logit_scale.exp() * cls_pred
    return cls_pred
```

配上 `logit_scale` 的注册（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L419-L420](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L419-L420)）：

```python
logit_scale = torch.tensor(4.6052, dtype=torch.float32)
self.register_buffer('logit_scale', logit_scale, persistent=False)
```

阅读提示：

- `self.cls_embed[:, 2:, :]` 的 `2` 与配置里 `stuff_classes=[0, 1]`（[configs/...py:L136](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L136)）、评估器 `stuff_class_inds=[0,1]`（[L286](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L286)）是**同一个语义类别体系的三处呼应**：wall/floor 只参与语义/全景，不参与实例分类。
- 整个函数没有任何可学习参数——分类的全部「知识」都在原型文件与投影头里，这就是球面分类的可替换性所在。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用小张量验证 max-over-prototypes、温度缩放与「背景列恒 0」。

**操作步骤**（示例代码）：

```python
import torch, torch.nn.functional as F
torch.manual_seed(0)
D, C, P, N = 8, 6, 3, 4                    # 缩小规模便于观察
prototypes = F.normalize(torch.randn(D, C, P), dim=0)   # 已归一化原型
prototypes = torch.cat([prototypes,
    torch.zeros(D, 1, P)], dim=1)          # 补背景类 → (D, 7, P)

cls_embd = torch.randn(N, D)
sim = torch.einsum('nd,dkp->nkp', F.normalize(cls_embd, dim=-1), prototypes)
logits = sim.max(-1).values * torch.tensor(4.6052).exp()

print('形状:', logits.shape)               # (4, 7)
print('背景列（最后一列）:', logits[:, -1])  # 应全为 0
# 手工对照一个元素
n, k, p = 1, 2, sim[1, 2].argmax()
manual = torch.dot(F.normalize(cls_embd, dim=-1)[1], prototypes[:, 2, p]) * 100
print('手工值:', manual.item(), 'vs', logits[1, 2].item())
```

**需要观察的现象**：形状 (4, 7)；背景列全 0；手工值与 einsum 结果一致（原型已归一化时内积即余弦）。

**预期结果**：以上三点全部成立；把 `* 100` 去掉后 softmax 会明显变平（可自行打印 `logits.softmax(-1)` 对比）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么用 `max` 而不是 `mean` 聚合一个类的 P 个原型？

**答案**：多模板原型刻画「同一类的多种说法」，一个查询只要与其中一种说法强匹配就应属于该类；`mean` 会被不相关模板稀释（比如 "a seat with legs" 与点云不太像，但 "a chair" 很像，mean 会拉低分数）。max 还保证增删模板不改变已匹配查询的分数语义。

**练习 2**：如果删除 `logit_scale`（τ=1），训练会发生什么？

**答案**：余弦取值域只有 [-1,1]，19 类的 softmax 会接近均匀分布，交叉熵梯度极小、损失曲线平缓，模型难以收敛到尖锐的类别判断。τ≈100 是 CLIP 论文中温度参数的初始值，用于把余弦差距放大到适合 softmax 的量级。

**练习 3**：实例路径 `cls_embed[:, 2:, :]` 切掉的是哪两类？如果换成 Matterport3D 这类别集不同的数据集，需要改动哪里？

**答案**：切掉的是语义类别体系中索引 0、1 的 wall 和 floor（stuff 类，不构成实例）。换数据集需要：用新数据集类别名重新生成 `cls_embedding.pth`（P 个模板 × 新类别数 C）、更新配置中 `num_semantic_classes`/`num_instance_classes` 与 stuff 类索引，解码器代码本身（`[:, 2:, :]`）只在 stuff 类仍恰为前 2 个时才不用改。

### 4.4 `_forward_head` 的 last_flag 语义分支与两套投影头

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`UnifiedQueryDecoder` 重写了父类的 `_forward_head`，把「每个查询同时做实例分类与语义分类」接进迭代预测循环。关键设计是 `last_flag` 参数：

- **实例分类（cls_preds）每一层都算**：6 层解码 + 初始一次 = 7 份预测，前 6 份进 `aux_outputs` 深监督（承接 u4-l3）；
- **语义分类（sem_preds）只在最后一层算**（`last_flag=True`）：语义分割本质是「每个超点属于哪类」的逐点判断，由最终掩码 + 每查询的语义标签合成即可，中间层的语义预测既贵又欠成熟，算一次就够。

于是同一份 `norm_query`、同一份 `pred_mask`、同一份 `maskpool_`，被两套投影头分别加工：实例头（`mask_pooling_proj` + `cls_proj` + 切片原型）与语义头（`mask_pooling_proj_sem` + `cls_proj_sem` + 全量原型）。另注意配置 `objectness_flag=False`（[configs/...py:L64](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L64)），所以 `scores` 恒为 None——实例置信度完全来自 `cls_preds`（推理侧 softmax，u6-l1）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
_forward_head(queries, mask_feats, last_flag):        # 每个场景 i 循环
  norm_query = out_norm(queries[i])                    # (N, 256)
  pred_mask = einsum('nd,md->nm', norm_query, mask_feats[i])   # (N, M)
  ── sphere_cls 分支 ──
  maskpool_ = mask_pool(mask_feats[i].T, pred_mask.detach())  # (N, 256)
  # 实例路（每层都走）
  cls_embd = cls_proj( mask_pooling_proj(maskpool_) + norm_query )
  cls_preds.append(forward_logit(cls_embd))            # (N, 19)
  # 语义路（仅 last_flag）
  if last_flag:
      cls_embd_sem = cls_proj_sem( mask_pooling_proj_sem(maskpool_) + norm_query )
      sem_preds.append(forward_logit(cls_embd_sem, sem=True))  # (N, 21)
  ── 注意力掩码（attn_mask=True）──
  attn_mask 由 pred_mask.sigmoid() < 0.5 派生（u4-l3 已讲）

forward_iter_pred 调用节奏：
  初始 _forward_head(last_flag=False)          # 第 1 份 cls_preds
  for i in 0..5:
      cross_attn → self_attn → ffn
      _forward_head(last_flag=(i == 5))         # 第 2..7 份；仅 i=5 带 sem
  返回末层 cls/sem/masks + aux_outputs（前 6 份，sem 均为 None）
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

球面分支主体（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L477-L491](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L477-L491)）：

```python
pred_mask = torch.einsum('nd,md->nm', norm_query, mask_feats[i])

if self.sphere_cls:
    maskpool_ = self.mask_pooling(x=mask_feats[i].T, mask=pred_mask.detach())

    maskpool_embd = self.mask_pooling_proj(maskpool_)
    cls_embd = self.cls_proj(maskpool_embd + norm_query)
    cls_pred = self.forward_logit(cls_embd)
    cls_preds.append(cls_pred)
    if last_flag:
        norm_query_sem = norm_query.clone()
        maskpool_embd_sem = self.mask_pooling_proj_sem(maskpool_)
        cls_embd_sem = self.cls_proj_sem(maskpool_embd_sem + norm_query_sem)
        cls_pred_sem = self.forward_logit(cls_embd_sem, sem=True)
        sem_preds.append(cls_pred_sem)
```

注意三处细节：

1. `x=mask_feats[i].T`：把 (M, 256) 转成 (256, M) 以符合 `mask_pool` 的 `[D, M]` 约定。

**练习 1**：为什么语义分支只在最后一层计算，而实例分支每层都算？

**练习 2**：`_forward_head` 里实例路与语义路共用同一份 `maskpool_`，语义分类会不会因此「被实例掩码带偏」？

**练习 3**：配置里 `objectness_flag=False`，那推理时实例的置信度分数从哪来？

## 5. 综合实践

**任务**：完整复现「mask_pool → 池化投影 → cls_proj → forward_logit」流水线，核对实例/语义 logits 的类别维数。

**第 1 步：体检原型文件**（见 4.1.4）。若尚未下载 `scannet_cls_embedding.pth`，可先用合成原型跑通第 2 步，下载后再回来核对真实维度。

**第 2 步：8 查询 × 50 点的最小复现**（示例代码，只需 torch；在项目根目录执行）：

```python
# sphere_cls_repro.py
import importlib.util, torch, torch.nn as nn, torch.nn.functional as F

# —— 可切换：真实文件 or 合成原型 ——
try:
    proto_raw = torch.load('data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth')  # (C,P,D)
except FileNotFoundError:
    C, P, D = 20, 3, 768                       # 合成替代（数值待本地验证）
    proto_raw = F.normalize(torch.randn(C, P, D), dim=2)
C, P, D = proto_raw.shape
print('原型:', proto_raw.shape)                # 期望 (20, P, 768)

# 补背景类 → (C+1, P, D) → permute → (D, C+1, P)
prototypes = torch.cat(
    [proto_raw, torch.zeros(1, P, D)], 0).permute(2, 0, 1).contiguous()

# 直载 mask_pool，避免触发 uniseg3d/__init__.py
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mp', 'uniseg3d/mask_pool.py')
mp = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mp)

# —— 模拟解码器末层 ——
torch.manual_seed(0)
N, M, d_model = 8, 50, 256                     # 8 个查询、50 个超点
norm_query  = F.normalize(torch.randn(N, d_model), dim=-1)   # out_norm 后的查询
mask_feats  = torch.randn(M, d_model)          # x_mask 输出
pred_mask   = norm_query @ mask_feats.T        # (N, M) 掩码 logits

maskpool_     = mp.mask_pool(x=mask_feats.T, mask=pred_mask.detach())  # (N,256)
pool_proj     = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(d_model), nn.Linear(d_model, d_model))
pool_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(nn.LayerNorm(d_model), nn.Linear(d_model, d_model))
cls_proj      = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(d_model, D))
cls_proj_sem  = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(),
    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(d_model, D))

def forward_logit(embd, sem=False):
    p = prototypes if sem else prototypes[:, 2:, :]
    return (torch.einsum('nd,dkp->nkp', F.normalize(embd, dim=-1), p)
            .max(-1).values) * 100.0

cls_embd     = cls_proj(pool_proj(maskpool_) + norm_query)
cls_embd_sem = cls_proj_sem(pool_proj_sem(maskpool_) + norm_query)
inst_logits, sem_logits = forward_logit(cls_embd), forward_logit(cls_embd_sem, True)
print('实例 logits:', inst_logits.shape)       # 期望 (8, 19)
print('语义 logits:', sem_logits.shape)        # 期望 (8, 21)
print('实例背景列恒 0:', bool((inst_logits[:, -1] == 0).all()))
print('argmax 类别（实例）:', inst_logits.argmax(-1))
```

**第 3 步：核对与观察**：

1. `maskpool_` 形状 (8, 256)；实例 logits **(8, 19)**、语义 logits **(8, 21)**（以 C=20 为前提，用真实文件时请复核）。
2. 实例 logits 最后一列（背景）全 0；语义 logits 最后一列是背景列，会被语义损失切掉。
3. 把 `norm_query` 置零再跑一次：分类完全由 `maskpool_`（掩码区域特征）决定——感受「查询身份」与「掩码内容」两路信息的相加融合。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **球面分类 = 用外部 CLIP 文本原型替换线性分类头**：`out_cls`/`out_sem` 在 `sphere_cls=True` 下不创建，分类知识全部来自 `scannet_cls_embedding.pth`（(C=20, P, D)，补全零 back_token 后 (D, 21, P) 存为非持久 buffer），换词表不必改网络。
- **mask_pool 是「掩码区域特征提取器」**：logits>0 二值化 + 行归一化 + einsum 平均；掩码侧 detach 断梯度，梯度只流向点特征；全空掩码靠 1e-8 兜底。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲补完了解码器的「分类侧」，至此模型四大件（骨干 u4-l2、解码器 u4-l3/本讲、语言分支）只剩语言分支未读：

# u4-l4 UnifiedQueryDecoder：CLIP 词表分类与 mask pooling

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u4-l3）我们读完了 `QueryDecoder` 的骨架：超点即查询、掩码注意力、迭代预测，并在结尾留下一个悬念——「分类改走球面分类路径，语义分支仅在最后一层计算」。本讲就把这个悬念拆开：

1. 理解 `sphere_cls`（球面分类）如何用**外部文本原型**替代传统线性分类头，以及这对开放词汇分割的意义。
2. 掌握 `mask_pool` 的 einsum 归一化池化：如何从「预测掩码内部的点特征」汇取出每个查询的分类特征。
3. 读懂 `forward_logit` 中 max-over-prototypes 与 `logit_scale` 的作用。
4. 区分实例分类与语义分类**两套投影头**（`cls_proj` / `cls_proj_sem`、`mask_pooling_proj` / `mask_pooling_proj_sem`），以及 `last_flag` 控制的语义分支时机。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 线性分类头 vs 原型分类

传统分割模型的分类头是一个可学习矩阵：

\[ \text{logits} = W q + b, \quad W \in \mathbb{R}^{(K+1) \times d} \]

它有两个特点：**权重是训练学出来的**、**类别数 K 在建模时就钉死了**。想新增一个类别，就必须改网络、重新训练。

原型（prototype）分类换了一种思路：每个类别的「权重向量」不由训练得到，而是用**文本编码器**（这里是 OpenCLIP）对一个类别名的文本嵌入来充当。分类变成计算查询嵌入与各类原型的**余弦相似度**：

\[ \cos(e, c) = \frac{\langle e, c \rangle}{\|e\| \, \|c\|} \]

由于归一化后的向量都落在单位超球面上，这种分类常被称为**球面分类**（sphere classification）。它正是 CLIP 做零样本分类的方式——想换类别，只需换一组文本嵌入，网络结构不动。这就是 `sphere_cls=True` 的含义，也是 UniSeg3D 开放词汇能力（u6-l3）与文本-视觉对齐（u4-l5、u5-l6）的基石。

### 2.2 mask pooling（掩码池化）

分类不能只看查询向量本身——两个「椅子」查询和两个「桌子」查询的向量可能很接近，但它们**掩住的点**截然不同。mask pooling 的做法是：用预测掩码圈出点（这里是超点）特征，在掩码内做**平均池化**，得到「这个查询掩住了什么东西」的特征，再与查询向量相加后送去分类。这一思想来自 Mask2Former 等二阶段掩码分类模型。

### 2.3 需要的背景概念

- **buffer（`register_buffer`）**：PyTorch 中随模型保存/移动但不参与梯度更新的张量；`persistent=False` 表示**不写入 state_dict**（checkpoint）。
- **DDP 广播（`dist.broadcast`）**：多卡训练时把 rank 0 的张量广播到所有进程，保证各卡的常量完全一致。
- **einsum**：用下标字符串描述张量运算，如 `'nd,md->nm'` 表示两个矩阵相乘。
- 承接 u4-l3：解码器每层输出 `pred_mask = einsum('nd,md->nm', norm_query, mask_feats)`，本讲的池化与分类都建立在这份掩码之上。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 cls_embed：类别原型加载与 back_token 广播

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

球面分类需要一个「类别 → 原型向量」的查找表。UniSeg3D 把这张表做成了一个三维张量文件 `data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth`，其布局为：

\[ \text{cls\_embed} \in \mathbb{R}^{C \times P \times D} \]

- \( C \)：类别数。由代码与配置联立可推出 **C = 20**（20 个 ScanNet 语义类，详见 4.1.2）。
- \( P \)：每个类别的**原型个数**。一个类可以用多条文本模板（如 "a chair" / "a seat with legs"）各编码一个原型，推理时取最大相似度——代码不关心 P 具体是多少，直接 `size(1)` 读出（具体数值待本地验证）。
- \( D \)：CLIP 文本嵌入维度。原型与语言分支（u4-l5）用同一个 OpenCLIP 模型编码（README L126），`convnext_large_d_320` 的文本维是 768，但确切值以文件为准（待本地验证）。

模型侧还要补一个**背景类**（back_token）：一个全零原型，充当「我不是任何东西」的第 \(C+1\) 类。这一步在 `__init__` 里完成，并把结果注册为 buffer。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
torch.load(pth)                          # (C, P, D)
读取 _dim=D、_prototypes=P
rank0 造全零 back_token(1, D)，其余 rank 造空张量
dist.broadcast 对齐所有卡                  # 保证背景原型各卡一致
back_token.repeat(P, 1)[None]            # (1, P, D)
cat 到类别维                             # (C+1, P, D)
permute(2, 0, 1)                         # (D, C+1, P) ← 方便 einsum
register_buffer('cls_embed', persistent=False)
```

两个关键推论（由 `forward_logit` 的切片反推，4.3 详述）：

- **语义分类**用全部 \(C+1\) 行 → logits 有 \(C+1 = 21\) 列 = `num_semantic_classes(20) + 1`，与配置 [configs/...py:L11](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L11) 一致；
- **实例分类**丢弃前 2 行（wall=0、floor=1 两个 stuff 类，对应配置 `stuff_classes=[0, 1]`）→ \(C-1 = 19\) 列 = `num_instance_classes(18) + 1`（18 个 thing 类 + 背景），与 [configs/...py:L10](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L10) 一致。

因此 **C 必为 20**——这正是「语义类去掉 2 个 stuff 类 = 实例类」的类别体系。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

配置侧打开球面分类并指定原型文件（[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:L47-L66](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L47-L66)）：解码器为 `UnifiedQueryDecoder`，`sphere_cls = True`，`vocabulary_cls_embedding_path = 'data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth'`。

原型加载与 back_token 广播（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L389-L406](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L389-L406)）：

```python
if self.sphere_cls:
    rank, world_size = get_dist_info()
    cls_embed = torch.load(vocabulary_cls_embedding_path)

    _dim = cls_embed.size(2)        # D
    _prototypes = cls_embed.size(1) # P

    if rank == 0:
        back_token = torch.zeros(1, _dim, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
    else:
        back_token = torch.empty(1, _dim, dtype=torch.float32, device='cuda')
    if world_size > 1:
        dist.broadcast(back_token, src=0)
    back_token = back_token.to(device='cpu')
    cls_embed = torch.cat([
        cls_embed, back_token.repeat(_prototypes, 1)[None]
    ], dim=0)
    self.register_buffer('cls_embed', cls_embed.permute(2, 0, 1).contiguous(),
                         persistent=False)
```

这段代码做了三件事：

1. **加载原型**并读出 \(P\)、\(D\)；`back_token.repeat(_prototypes, 1)[None]` 把 1 个零向量复制成 (1, P, D)，即背景类也有 P 个（全零）原型，与其它类形状对齐。
2. **DDP 安全**：rank 0 造零、其余 rank 造未初始化内存、广播对齐——确保多卡训练时背景原型 bit 级一致。注意 `device='cuda'`：**在没有 GPU 的机器上无法实例化 `UnifiedQueryDecoder(sphere_cls=True)`**，做实验时要么用 GPU，要么像本讲实践那样手工复现流水线。
3. **`persistent=False`**：`cls_embed` 不进 checkpoint。好处是换词表不用改权重文件；代价是**任何构建模型的环境（包括纯推理）都必须存在这个 pth 文件**，否则 `torch.load` 直接报错。

两个线性分类头在球面模式下**根本不会被创建**（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L210-L213](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L210-L213) 与 [L380-L387](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L380-L387)）：`out_cls` 与 `out_sem` 都被 `if not self.sphere_cls` 守卫。所以球面分类不是「并列选项」，而是**完全替换**了分类参数——模型里不存在 \(19 \times 256\) 或 \(21 \times 256\) 的可学习分类矩阵。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `cls_embed` 要 `permute(2, 0, 1)` 存成 (D, C+1, P)，而不是保持 (C+1, P, D)？

**答案**：为了与 `forward_logit` 里的 `einsum('nd,dkp->nkp', ...)` 下标约定对齐——einsum 要求参与运算的维度按下标出现，把嵌入维 D 放到 dim0 后，查询嵌入 (n, d) 可以直接与原型 (d, k, p) 相乘，不需要额外转置；同时实例分类的「丢掉前两类」变成一个直观的 `[:, 2:, :]` 切片。

**练习 2**：删掉 `data/scannet/scannet_cls_embedding.pth` 后加载一个训练好的 checkpoint 做推理，会发生什么？为什么？

**答案**：会在**构建模型阶段**就报错（`torch.load` 文件不存在），根本轮不到加载 checkpoint。因为 `persistent=False`，原型不随 checkpoint 保存，每次实例化 `UnifiedQueryDecoder` 都要重新读 pth——推理环境同样依赖该文件。

**练习 3**：back_token 为什么要在 rank 0 上 `zeros`、其它 rank 上 `empty` 再广播，而不是每张卡各自 `zeros`？

**答案**：这是多进程训练中的防御性写法。虽然 `zeros` 本身是确定性的，但该模式能确保「所有 rank 上的 buffer 来自同一次初始化」，杜绝任何 rank 间数值不一致的可能（这类写法常见于需要随机初始化再对齐的常量场景）；广播后统一搬回 CPU 参与后续 `torch.cat`。

### 4.2 mask_pool 与两个池化投影头

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`mask_pool` 回答的问题是：**「第 n 个查询掩住的区域长什么样？」**

输入是点（超点）特征矩阵 \(X \in \mathbb{R}^{D_{in} \times M}\)（\(D_{in}=256=d\_model\)，\(M\) 为该场景超点数）和掩码 logits \(M_{logit} \in \mathbb{R}^{N \times M}\)（\(N\) 为查询数）。它先把 logits 二值化（>0 即视为掩内），再做**归一化平均**：

\[ x_n^{pool} = \frac{\sum_{m} \mathbb{1}[M_{logit,n,m} > 0] \cdot X_{:,m}}{\sum_{m} \mathbb{1}[M_{logit,n,m} > 0] + 10^{-8}} \in \mathbb{R}^{D_{in}} \]

分母加 `1e-8` 防止「掩码全空」的查询除零。两个工程细节值得注意：

- **掩码侧梯度被切断**：`with torch.no_grad()` + `mask.detach()`，池化只把掩码当「区域选择器」，梯度只回流到点特征 \(X\)（即 `mask_feats`）上。掩码 logits 自己的监督来自掩码损失（u5）。
- **二值化阈值是 0（logit）而非 0.5（概率）**：等价于对 sigmoid 概率取 0.5 阈值，与解码器里生成注意力掩码的阈值一致（u4-l3）。

池化结果随后经**两套对称的投影头**加工：

| 头 | 结构 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mask_pooling_proj` | LayerNorm + Linear(256→256) | 实例分类分支的池化投影 |
| `mask_pooling_proj_sem` | LayerNorm + Linear(256→256) | 语义分类分支的池化投影（独立参数） |
| `cls_proj` | Linear-ReLU ×2 + Linear(256→D) | 池化特征+查询 → 实例分类嵌入 |
| `cls_proj_sem` | Linear-ReLU ×2 + Linear(256→D) | 池化特征+查询 → 语义分类嵌入 |

实例与语义**各自一套完整参数**，互不共享——因为两个任务的类别空间与判别习惯不同（实例要区分「哪把椅子」，语义只需「是椅子」）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
mask_feats[i]                # (M, 256) 点(超点)特征
        │ .T
        ▼
mask_pool(x=(256, M),        mask=pred_mask.detach() (N, M)
        │  内部: logits>0 二值化 → 行归一化 → einsum('dm,nm->nd')
        ▼
maskpool_ (N, 256)           # 每个查询「掩住区域」的平均特征
        ├── mask_pooling_proj     ──┐
        └── mask_pooling_proj_sem ──┤（同一份 maskpool_ 喂两个头）
                                    ▼
              各自 + norm_query → cls_proj / cls_proj_sem → 球面分类
```

注意一个容易被忽略的点：**语义分支复用的是同一份 `maskpool_`**（来自实例掩码的池化），只是后续投影不同。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

`mask_pool` 函数（[uniseg3d/mask_pool.py:L5-L21](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/mask_pool.py#L5-L21)）：

```python
def mask_pool(x, mask):
    """
    Args:
        x: [D, M]
        mask: [N, M]
    """
    with torch.no_grad():
        mask = mask.detach()
        mask = (mask > 0).to(mask.dtype)
        denorm = mask.sum(dim=(-1), keepdim=True) + 1e-8

    mask_pooled_x = torch.einsum(
        "dm,nm->nd",
        x,
        mask / denorm,
    )
    return mask_pooled_x
```

`no_grad` 块只包住掩码处理；`einsum` 在块外，因此梯度经 `x` 正常回传、经 `mask` 断流。`mask / denorm` 让每行权重和为 1（掩内点的平均）。

四个投影头与池化函数的组装（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L408-L432](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L408-L432)）：

```python
cls_embed_dim = self.cls_embed.size(0)          # = D，原型嵌入维
self.cls_proj = nn.Sequential(                  # 实例分类嵌入
    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
    nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
    nn.Linear(d_model, cls_embed_dim))
self.cls_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(...)          # 同构，语义版

self.mask_pooling = mask_pool                   # 函数别名
self.mask_pooling_proj = nn.Sequential(         # 实例池化投影
    nn.LayerNorm(d_model), nn.Linear(d_model, d_model))
self.mask_pooling_proj_sem = nn.Sequential(...) # 语义池化投影
```

两点说明：

1. `cls_proj` 的输出维是 `cls_embed_dim = self.cls_embed.size(0)`，即 permute 后的 dim0 = \(D\)。**投影头把 256 维查询空间升维到 CLIP 文本空间**，与原型做相似度——这正是「把视觉查询翻译到语言空间」的接口。
2. `self.mask_pooling = mask_pool` 里的 `mask_pool` 是 **query_decoder.py 自己内嵌的那份**（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:L11-L27](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L11-L27)），与 mask_pool.py 逐字相同但互不引用；`uniseg3d/__init__.py` 也不导入 mask_pool.py，所以它是一份「独立工具副本」，恰好方便我们单独测试。
